verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison is an agent platform, so letting users plug in MCP servers as tools is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. The docs cover only API-key auth, task submission via JobNames, file uploads, chat sessions and runtime configuration, none of which is MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
